about: MIT OpenCourseWare course home pages: every undergraduate course on OCW plus every graduate course with full lecture videos, across all MIT departments. Khan Academy units are not included (site served a bot challenge).
collected: ocw.mit.edu/sitemap.xml (sitemap index listing every course site), then each course's /data.json (title, instructors, level, topics, resource types) and course home page (page title, JSON-LD license). Khan Academy (www.khanacademy.org, /math, /sitemap.xml) returned a JavaScript 'Client Challenge' page to curl and WebFetch, so nothing could be collected from it.
